evalCriteria.prompt: Review every changed frontend file. Score 0 if any changed frontend code recomputes prorated_charge, daily_delta, or days_remaining from raw plan prices/dates instead of rendering the value returned by GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview. Cite the file and line.

evalCriteria.metric: Deterministic dummy gateway, no external dependency
evalCriteria.prompt: Review the diff for charge_card() and any new dependency declarations. Score 0 if a third-party payment SDK/package was added to requirements.txt or package.json, or if charge_card contains a network call (requests/httpx/socket) rather than a pure in-process decision on the email string. Cite the file and line.

Review the POST /api/billing/upgrade handler. Score 0 if any write to users[email] or billing_data[email] occurs before, or independently of, the charge_card() decline check — i.e. any path where a card_declined result still leaves a mutation applied. Cite the file and line.

Review both GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview and POST /api/billing/upgrade. Score 0 if either handler is missing the already-Premium check, or performs proration/charge work before that check runs. Cite the file and line.
Review the diff for any assignment to a renew_at key on users[email] or billing_data[email] inside the upgrade flow. Score 0 if any such assignment exists. Cite the file and line.
